# Jobs Done Labs

> Jobs Done Labs builds custom automation systems for small and mid-size businesses, focused on recovering $30K+ in lost revenue or wasted operations cost within 90 days.

## What we do
- Custom business automation systems (workflow automation, AI agents, integrations)
- Revenue-recovery audits: find where money leaks in ops, then automate the fix
- Built and operated by Ryne Bandolik (BCAT portfolio: logistics, cartage, fitness)

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/): offer, process, case studies, and booking link
- [Stop chasing clients for documents](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/stop-chasing-client-documents/): why email follow-up fails at accounting/bookkeeping firms and the automated request-and-reminder workflow that ends the document chase
- [Shopify payouts never match QuickBooks?](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/shopify-quickbooks-reconciliation-never-matches/): why Shopify payouts structurally never match QuickBooks — batch settlement, fees deducted pre-deposit, multi-order netting — and the 4 ways to fix it, honestly compared
- [Fuel receipts & expense tracking for trucking](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/trucking-fuel-receipts-expense-tracking-fix/): what the IRS and IFTA actually require, a 3-tier system that works from the truck cab, and a Friday-afternoon checklist to stop being the person with a shoe box of receipts
- [Subcontractor paperwork for small GCs](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/subcontractor-paperwork-management-system-gc/): the 5 documents every GC must collect (W-9, COI, contract, lien waiver, safety cert), what happens when each is missing, and a 3-tier system to tame it without buying another platform
- [The real fix for the contractor estimate time drain](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/contractor-estimate-time-management/): why charging for estimates isn't the first answer — the pre-qualification funnel and 3-tier estimate system that cut 500+ unpaid hours a year and raise close rates
- [A job-costing system that works from the jobsite](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/contractor-job-costing-system-field-to-office/): why QuickBooks job costing fails small contractors, the 4 numbers that prove a job's profit, and a 3-tier field-to-office system your crew will actually use
- [What comes after the whiteboard production schedule](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/small-manufacturing-production-scheduling-guide/): the signs a small manufacturer has outgrown spreadsheet/whiteboard scheduling, the 4 components every system needs, and an honest spreadsheet → MRP → ERP migration path
- [Closing the inventory spreadsheet gap](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/small-manufacturer-inventory-management-system/): the 5 reasons counts drift, the minimum viable inventory system (owner, cycle counts, bin locations, reorder triggers), and an automation ladder from Sheets to custom glue
- [Marketing agency client reporting automation](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/marketing-agency-client-reporting-automation-guide/): small agencies losing 36+ billable hours/month to manual report assembly — the 3-tier fix from Google Looker to fully automated white-label dashboards
- [Medical practice provider credentialing tracking](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/medical-practice-provider-credentialing-tracking-system/): why new providers can't bill for 5 months and practices lose $30K+/provider — the 3-tier credentialing tracking system that fixes the payer queue backlog
- [Small business purchase order tracking system](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/small-business-purchase-order-tracking-system/): tracking 50+ POs across WhatsApp and an unupdated spreadsheet costs $50K/year in stockouts — the 3-tier system from Google Sheets to full automation
- [Trucking detention pay tracking system](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/trucking-detention-pay-tracking-system/): how fleets lose $200K/year in unpaid detention, why manual tracking fails, and the 4-step system to recover $100K+ without a $500/month TMS
- [Truck inventory second-trip prevention](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/truck-inventory-second-trip-prevention/): why "the truck is stocked" costs $500–1,500/month per 5-tech shop and the 3-part $0 inventory system that stops second trips
- [Warehouse pick/pack error reduction system](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/warehouse-pick-pack-error-reduction-system/): 270 monthly pick errors costing $5,400 — the free phone-camera and scale system that cuts errors in half by Friday
- [Manufacturing job costing without ERP](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/manufacturing-job-costing-without-erp/): 40% of jobs run over cost when quoting by feel — the $0 spreadsheet system that stops underpricing without buying an ERP
- [E-commerce manual data entry silent killer](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/ecommerce-manual-data-entry-silent-killer/): 15 hours/week copying numbers between platforms while Amazon flags you for overselling — the 5-level inventory sync system starting at $0
- [Truck fleet maintenance tracking system](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/truck-fleet-maintenance-tracking-system/): a missed oil change leading to a $24K engine rebuild — the 5-level fleet maintenance system from free spreadsheet to full automation
- [Contractor proof-of-work service verification](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/contractor-proof-of-work-service-verification-system/): customer chargebacks costing $15,200/year — the 5-point documentation system that proves every job was completed, starting with your phone
- [Manual prior authorization workflow for small practices](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/manual-prior-authorization-workflow-small-practice/): 16 hours/week on PAs costing $35K–$45K/year — the manual workflow that cuts time in half when every software solution costs more than the problem
- [Construction crew paper timesheet system](https://www.jobsdonelabs.ai/blog/construction-crew-time-tracking-paper-timesheet-system/): foremen filling out timesheets in trucks at 6PM loses 2–3 billable hours/week — the paper timesheet capture system that fixes it, no app required
